name: Polygenic Risk Score
overview: 利用 GWAS summary statistics 预测个体遗传风险。支持 Clumping+Thresholding（PRSice-2）、Bayesian 连续收缩（LDpred2、PRS-CS）三种方法，覆盖数据准备、QC、PRS 计算和模型评估。
overviewEn: Uses GWAS summary statistics to predict individual genetic risk. Supports Clumping+Thresholding (PRSice-2) and Bayesian continuous shrinkage (LDpred2, PRS-CS) methods, covering data preparation, QC, PRS calculation, and model evaluation.

steps.name: 准备数据
steps.description: Base data: GWAS summary statistics（β, SE, P, SNP, EA, OA）；Target data: 个体基因型（PLINK format）
steps.descriptionEn: Base data: GWAS summary statistics (β, SE, P, SNP, EA, OA); Target data: individual genotypes (PLINK format)

tools.name: PLINK
tools.notes: Target data 需为 PLINK 格式（bed/bim/fam）。
tools.notesEn: Target data must be in PLINK format (bed/bim/fam).

steps.notes: Target data 需为 PLINK 格式（bed/bim/fam）。
steps.notesEn: Target data must be in PLINK format (bed/bim/fam).

steps.name: 质量控制
steps.description: Base: 移除低质量 SNP（MAF < 0.01, INFO < 0.8）；Target: 标准 GWAS QC；正链对齐
steps.descriptionEn: Base: remove low-quality SNPs (MAF < 0.01, INFO < 0.8); Target: standard GWAS QC; forward-strand alignment

steps.name: PRS 计算
steps.description: C+T（PRSice-2）/ Bayesian 连续收缩（LDpred2, PRS-CS）

tools.name: PRSice-2
tools.notes: C+T 方法。--fastscore 只计算指定阈值。
tools.notesEn: C+T method. --fastscore computes only specified thresholds.

tools.name: LDpred2 (bigsnpr)
tools.notes: Bayesian 自动调参，推荐。需要 LD 参考面板。
tools.notesEn: Bayesian auto-tuning, recommended. Requires LD reference panel.

tools.name: PRS-CS
tools.notes: Bayesian 连续收缩，大样本推荐。PRS-CS-auto 自动调参。
tools.notesEn: Bayesian continuous shrinkage, recommended for large samples. PRS-CS-auto for auto-tuning.

steps.notes: C+T 方法。--fastscore 只计算指定阈值。 Bayesian 自动调参，推荐。需要 LD 参考面板。 Bayesian 连续收缩，大样本推荐。PRS-CS-auto 自动调参。
steps.notesEn: C+T method. --fastscore computes only specified thresholds. Bayesian auto-tuning, recommended. Requires LD reference panel. Bayesian continuous shrinkage, recommended for large samples. PRS-CS-auto for auto-tuning.
